caveats: No per-cell MHW (run of >=5 hot days) occurred in any of the 3309 sea cells in the target period; the longest hot run was 4 days, so the regional event list is empty. Baseline pools use the calendar windows for 1992-2002 (extension days 1991-12-27..31 and 2003-01-01..05 included). Threshold/climatology NaN-free for sea cells. Land cells are 0 in the mask. Day of year follows the leap-year calendar mapping (day 60 skipped in non-leap years).
